Iran s foreign ministry said the United States had damaged international diplomatic efforts to end the war after further U.S. strikes on targets in southern Iran, while U.S. President Donald Trump said a deal with Iran could be signed and that the strategic Strait of Hormuz would be open to all immediately afterwards.
